messages.content: Hey, it's your Northline Care weekly check-in. How are you feeling this week? Any new readings to share, or anything going on with your medications?
Pretty good I think. Numbers been okay. Hey random question — my wife keeps buying these big loaves of white bread and I know I probably shouldn't be eating it. What can I eat instead?

Glad things feel okay! I have to be straight with you though — diet advice is one thing I'm not set up to give. Your doctor or a dietitian would be the right people to ask about swaps like that, worth bringing it up at your next appointment. Can you tell me what your blood pressure or blood sugar has been running this week?
Yeah figured it was a long shot. BP this morning was 141 over 88.
Thanks for that — logging it now. Any headaches, dizziness, chest tightness, anything that felt off?
Nah nothing like that. Felt fine.
Good to hear. I've got that reading recorded. Your next check-in is set for the same time next week — if anything changes before then, you can always text here. Take care out there.

theme: diet question, what to eat instead of bread
